text: dsh-plugin-devin-bridge 将 Devin Connect 注册为 DSH 的模型提供者，把对话与工具输入转换为 Devin 请求，并将文本、推理、工具调用和用量转换为 DSH 流式响应。它可发现 Devin 模型，支持 GLM-5.2、SWE-1.7 等模型及推理档位设置，并在 Plugins 设置卡片中编辑连接和模型目录。适合希望在 DSH 中使用 Devin 托管模型的用户。需要 Devin session token，可在设置中填写或由 Devin CLI 凭证文件提供。

dsh-plugin-devin-bridge connects Devin Connect as a DSH model provider. It translates conversations and tools, then streams Devin text, reasoning, and tool calls to DSH. Users can discover models and edit connection settings in a Plugins card. A Devin session token is required.

dsh-plugin-devin-bridge 的功能「模型目录发现」：在设置卡片点击 Fetch available models 后请求 Devin 的模型目录，并将结果列出供选择后保存。
dsh-plugin-devin-bridge 的功能「模型生成」：DSH 将对话与工具定义转换为 Devin Connect 请求，并将返回的文本、推理和工具调用增量转换成 DSH 流式内容。
dsh-plugin-devin-bridge 的功能「设置面板配置」：在 Plugins 设置卡片编辑 token、地址、代理和模型列表，保存到对应设置范围。
dsh-plugin-devin-bridge 需要 Devin session token 认证；未填写时会读取 Devin CLI 凭证，也可用 DEVIN_CREDENTIALS_PATH 指定凭证路径。

dsh-plugin-devin-bridge README · dsh-plugin-devin-bridge：[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) LLM adapter plugin that bridges [Devin](https://devin.ai)'s Connect RPC API into the dsh model provider system, enabling dsh's internal agent loop to use Devin-hosted models (`glm-5.2`, `swe-1.7`, and any other model Devin exposes) as backends.

dsh-plugin-devin-bridge README · How it works：The plugin registers a `devin` provider route on `ctx.llm` via the dsh LLM seam (`LlmAdapter`). When dsh's agent loop routes a request to `provider: devin`, the adapter:

1. Translates dsh's `GenerateOptions` (messages, tools, system prompt, images) into Devin's `GetChatMessageRequest` protobuf
2. Streams the response from Devin's Connect RPC endpoint
3. Decodes each `GetChatMessageResponse` frame into dsh's `StreamChunk` protocol (text deltas, reasoning deltas, tool-call deltas, usage, finish)

dsh-plugin-devin-bridge README · Installation：```bash
pnpm add https://github.com/Arborsm/dsh-plugin-devin-bridge.git
```
dsh-plugin-devin-bridge README · Token resolution：The adapter needs a Devin session token (format: `devin-session-token$<...>`) to authenticate. It resolves the token in priority order:

dsh-plugin-devin-bridge README · Token resolution：1. **Settings panel** — set `token` in the dsh settings UI (marked as secret, auto-redacted in wire responses)
2. **Entry config** — `config.token` in the plugin composition
3. **Devin CLI credentials** — automatically read from `credentials.toml` created by `devin auth login`:
   - Windows: `%APPDATA%\devin\credentials.toml`
   - macOS/Linux: `~/.local/share/devin/credentials.toml` (or `$XDG_DATA_HOME/devin/credentials.toml`)
   - Override path with `DEVIN_CREDENTIALS_PATH` environment variable
dsh-plugin-devin-bridge README · Token resolution：If no token is found, the plugin throws at startup with a actionable error message.

dsh-plugin-devin-bridge README · Configuration：All fields are optional — the plugin works out of the box once a token is available (via settings panel, entry config, or credentials.toml).

```yaml
- id: devin-bridge
  name: dsh-plugin-devin-bridge
  config:
    token: ""  # optional: explicit token; empty = auto-detect from credentials.toml

dsh-plugin-devin-bridge README · Configuration：When the dsh settings service is available, all of the above can be adjusted at runtime through the settings panel — changes take effect immediately (`live` applies). The `token` field is marked `role('secret')` so it is automatically redacted in settings descriptors returned to wire surfaces.

dsh-plugin-devin-bridge README · Usage：Once configured, dsh's model selector will show `Devin` as a provider with available models. Select any model in the dsh UI or route to it programmatically with `provider: devin`.

dsh-plugin-devin-bridge README · Features：- **Dynamic model catalog**: Fetches the live model list from Devin via `GetCascadeModelConfigs` RPC (5-minute TTL cache), merging user-configured models as fallback. Network failures gracefully fall back to the static config.
- **Text streaming**: Full text delta streaming with block assembly
- **Reasoning/thinking**: Reasoning content mapped to dsh's `reasoning` block type
- **Tool calls**: Devin tool-call deltas translated to dsh's `tool-call` blocks
- **Image support**: Vision-capable models accept image inputs via dsh's attachment system
- **Token usage**: Input/output token accounting reported to dsh
- **System prompt sanitization**: Identity-agnostic system prompt rewriting for cross-model compatibility
- **Proxy support**: Optional outbound HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 proxy
- **Settings panel integration**: Runtime-adjustable configuration via dsh settings service
- **Credential auto-detection**: Reads `devin auth login` credentials when no explicit token is configured
